name: Generated Agreement Review
description: Launched by the Fontara Statement of Work, Amendment, Change Order, Data Processing Addendum and Vendor Agreement document generation configurations (the owner 11-21, CLM realism item 8). It files the generated draft's attributes from the form (Agreement Profile: the agreement type and line of business the form carries as hidden fields, the Fontara entity, the counterparty (the customer, or the supplier on a vendor agreement) and the currency; Contract Process: Draft), then Legal Operations reviews it: due 2 business days, escalated to Approval Escalations after that. Approved: In Negotiation; rejected: back to Draft.

steps.name: Legal operations review
steps.subject: Generated draft to review
steps.instructions: A draft generated from a Fontara template. Check the clause positions picked (Standard, Acceptable or Fallback) and approve, or reject with a comment.

steps.name: Escalated: legal operations review
steps.subject: Escalated after 2 business days: generated draft to review
steps.instructions: Legal Operations did not answer within 2 business days, so this review comes to you. Check the clause positions and approve, or reject with a comment.
